dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you look tired. Did you stay up late again?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈlʊk ˈtaɪərd. dɪd juː ˈsteɪ ˈʌp ˈleɪt əˈɡɛn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I was reading an article about sleep.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ wʌz ˈriːdɪŋ ən ˈɑːrtɪkəl əˈbaʊt ˈsliːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: About sleep? What did it say?
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈsliːp? ˈwʌt dɪd ɪt ˈseɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: According to the article, students need about eight hours of sleep.
dialogue.reading: əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ði ˈɑːrtɪkəl, ˈstuːdənts ˈniːd əˈbaʊt ˈeɪt ˈaʊərz əv ˈsliːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is that from real research or just someone's opinion?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðæt frəm ˈriːəl ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ɔːr ˈdʒʌst ˈsʌmwʌnz əˈpɪnjən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's from research at a university in Japan.
dialogue.reading: ɪts frəm ˈriːsɜːrtʃ ət ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: According to the findings, students who use their phones in bed sleep one hour less.
dialogue.reading: əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz, ˈstuːdənts huː ˈjuːz ðɛr ˈfoʊnz ɪn ˈbɛd ˈsliːp ˈwʌn ˈaʊər ˈlɛs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. Is there any other evidence?
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈɛvədəns?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. According to sleep experts, the light from phones makes it hard to sleep.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ˈsliːp ˈɛkspɜːrts, ðə ˈlaɪt frəm ˈfoʊnz ˈmeɪks ɪt ˈhɑːrd tə ˈsliːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then put your phone away before bed, Nam!
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈpʊt jʊr ˈfoʊn əˈweɪ bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɛd, ˈnɑːm!
